description: This source file defines a class `NetworkEnv` which manages environment-driven network configuration for a Flutter app. It uses the `flutter_dotenv` package to load environment variables from a `.env` file, providing fallback defaults for URLs used in network communication (HTTP and WebSocket). It supports asynchronous loading and checking whether the environment is configured for a real backend.

classes.name: NetworkEnv
classes.description: A utility class providing environment-based configuration for network endpoints, supporting asynchronous loading and fallback defaults.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from `.env` file, only once.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a given environment variable key, returning an empty string if not found.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for REST API calls, falling back to 'http://localhost:8000' if not set.

methods.name: wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket base URL, falling back to 'ws://localhost:8000/ws' if not set.

methods.name: isConfiguredForRealBackend
methods.description: Boolean indicating if either API or WebSocket URLs are configured with non-empty values, implying a real backend setup.
